Company Description

About us

Solflare is a Solana self-custody wallet that puts people in control of their digital assets. Around 4 million users control $20 billion in funds through our wallet.

What started as a team of 6 in 2020 building Solana's first wallet, has grown into a team of 150 worldwide. We’re remote-first, but if you happen to stop by in Zagreb, Croatia, or Belgrade or Novi Sad, Serbia, we have an office you can work from if that’s what you prefer. 

Wherever we work, we share the same goal: a Web3 wallet for everyone, with financial freedom in their hands.

Job Description

The role

We're looking for a Senior SEO Specialist to own and advance Solflare's organic search strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.

We already have a solid SEO foundation in place. Your role won't be to start from scratch, but to build on what's working, identify untapped opportunities, and take our organic visibility to the next level.

You'll work on a large-scale website with potentially millions of indexed or indexable pages, where technical SEO, content strategy, and smart prioritization can have a significant impact.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who enjoys both strategic thinking and getting things done. You'll collaborate directly with experienced colleagues across Marketing, Product, and Engineering, with the autonomy to shape how we approach organic growth.

Core responsibilities:

  • Own and evolve our SEO strategy - Build on our existing foundation, identify growth opportunities, and translate them into a clear, actionable roadmap.
  • Drive organic search performance - Improve rankings, qualified organic traffic, and visibility for Solflare and its products across global markets.
  • Lead technical SEO initiatives - Identify and prioritize opportunities related to crawling, indexing, site architecture, internal linking, and performance across a large-scale website.
  • Optimize for traditional and AI-powered search - Develop approaches to improve Solflare's visibility in Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging discovery platforms.
  • Shape our content SEO strategy - Work with content creators and other stakeholders to ensure landing pages, product pages, and editorial content are built around search intent and measurable organic growth opportunities.
  • Strengthen off-page SEO - Identify and execute opportunities to improve domain authority, backlink quality, and competitive positioning.
  • Improve product discoverability - Support organic visibility for Solflare's browser extension and other relevant product discovery channels.
  • Measure what matters - Monitor performance, turn data into actionable insights, and continuously refine priorities based on impact.
  • Collaborate across teams - Partner with Marketing, Product, and Engineering to turn SEO opportunities into implemented improvements.

 

Qualifications

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with a track record of delivering measurable organic growth in competitive markets.
  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to SEO strategy, from identifying opportunities to executing and measuring results.
  • Strong understanding of technical SEO, including crawling, indexing, site architecture, internal linking, and large-scale website optimization.
  • Solid experience with on-page SEO, content optimization, off-page SEO, and link-building strategies.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and other SEO analytics and auditing platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI search optimization (AEO) and an interest in how search behavior and discovery are evolving.
  • A data-driven approach, with the ability to prioritize initiatives based on potential business impact.
  • Ability to work independently, challenge assumptions, and collaborate effectively.
  • Strong communication skills and professional proficiency in English.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in crypto, Web3, fintech, or another highly competitive digital industry.
  • Experience optimizing websites with a large number of dynamically generated pages.
  • Experience with international or multilingual SEO.
  • Knowledge of app store optimization (ASO) or Chrome Web Store discoverability.

 

Additional Information

You might not like it here…

But you might love it. Working at Solflare comes with trade-offs, and we’re open about them.

Crypto moves fast, and our priorities can shift with it. We launch new features and rethink existing projects as our users’ needs evolve, in bull and bear markets alike. That means a project you expected to work on may give way to a more pressing priority. We understand this can be energizing if you can adapt and reset as you go, and frustrating if you prefer long-term predictability.

We also highly rate how people work together. Yes, individual work matters, but so does helping others succeed. We share responsibility for the outcome, and we share credit for the wins.

Our remote-first setup gives you flexibility over how you work. It also means owning your role and proactively communicating with your team, not waiting for check-ins or constant direction.

A Web3 background isn’t a must, but interest in Solflare and the industry is. Using the product, asking questions, and contributing ideas is part of every role.

You don’t have to prefer this setup. But understanding it should help you decide whether you’d enjoy working here.

 


Millions already use what we build. Help shape what comes next. Apply below, or check out our careers site to learn more about our culture and benefits.

ABOUT US

Localcoin, founded in 2017 with headquarters in Toronto, is on a mission to simplify the process and experience of buying or selling digital currencies globally. We envision bringing digital currency to the mainstream financial market through partnerships with leading corporate and franchised retail spaces. With terminals across Canada, Poland and the APAC region, including Australia, Hong Kong, and New Zealand, Localcoin is now the fastest growing Bitcoin ATM operator in the world.

At its core, Localcoin believes that everyone should be able to own cryptocurrency and have a deep understanding of blockchain technology. As a member of our rapidly growing team, you'll join a talented, dynamic group of team members who will encourage you to learn, grow, and thrive in your career every step of the way.

If you're a self-starter looking to hone your skills in a startup environment that fosters innovation, transparency, and team connectivity, we look forward to hearing from you!

THE ROLE

Salary Range: $120,000 - $140,000

Localcoin seeks to inspire the future of digital currency globally as the largest bitcoin ATM network in Canada. We are looking for an individual who is passionate about learning new technologies to join our growing Engineering team as our Senior Java Back End Developer. 

As a Senior Java Back-End Developer at Localcoin, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining functional and stable back end applications for our company, ensuring system consistency and availability. Working alongside the Engineering team, you should have an unyielding desire to learn and broaden your horizon along with contributing towards daily deliverables. You should be a team player, familiar with the Agile framework of delivery.

This position will be based out of our office in Toronto, ON, and will have a hybrid work schedule of 2 days a week. 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING 

  • Work closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders to design and implement secure, scalable, and maintainable integration solutions aligned with business strategy.
  • Ensure applications and integrations adhere to best practices for security, compliance, and data protection, proactively identifying and mitigating vulnerabilities.
  • Develop, maintain, troubleshoot, and debug Java applications and integrations, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
  • Collaborate with UI teams to ensure seamless front-end and back-end interactions, optimizing for performance, security, and user experience.
  • Implement secure coding practices, conduct peer code reviews, and contribute to system stability and resilience.
  • Monitor application performance, identify bottlenecks, and enhance efficiency to improve user experience and system reliability.
  • Respond to integration issues, resolve production incidents efficiently, and contribute to post-mortem analysis and improvements.
  • Stay updated with the latest Java development trends, security best practices, and architectural improvements to enhance system robustness.
  • Guide and mentor junior developers, fostering a culture of learning, best practices, and technical excellence. Provide support through code reviews, technical guidance, and skill development.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 

  • 5+ years in backend development and strong knowledge in Java 8 along with Maven or Gradle.
  • In-depth experience with Spring framework, including Spring - Boot, JPA, MVC and Spring Security for building RESTful services.
  • Experience with functional testing, unit testing, code coverage and static code analysis tools such as Sonar.
  • Experience with BDD and related tools.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL. DDL, DML, relational database design and indexing in any well known SQL databases such as MySQL, Postgres, Oracle DB, MSSQL
  • Proficient in Git flow, Maven, NGINX and Docker.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with any CI/CD platforms on the cloud
  • Expertise on Linux platforms and shell commands
  • Good understanding of cloud environments like AWS/GPC
  • Experience in Angular/React JS
  • Expertise using Swagger and/or Postman tools
  • Good understanding about database-migration tools such as Flyway


WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT US

  • Competitive Salary & Benefits – We value and reward our team members.
  • RRSP Group Matching Program – We invest in your financial well-being.
  • Hybrid Work Environment – Enjoy flexibility while being part of a dynamic team.
  • Professional Development – Opportunities for learning and growth covered by Localcoin.
  • Team Culture & Events – Regular socials, team meetings, and collaborative workspaces.
  • Impactful Work – Play a key role in a growing company and make a real difference.
  • Great Place to Work® Certified – Proudly recognized for our positive workplace culture and employee experience.

JOIN OUR INCLUSIVE TEAM

Localcoin is committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and equitable workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, ancestry, place of origin, color, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, family status, or disability.

If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please notify the Talent team or email careers@localcoinatm.com.

Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Canada. At this time, we are not able to provide visa sponsorship.

AI DISCLOSURE STATEMENT

While technology helps us stay organized and efficient, every hiring decision at Localcoin is made by real people who care about finding the best addition to our team. These tools are used to support our process—not to replace the human judgment and connection that are core to our culture.

The impact you will have:

This NYC-based role will grow Elliptic’s existing customer marketing program into a lifecycle program that builds long-term relationships with our customers at every stage, from signature to renewal and advocacy. You will also build a community of compliance practitioners who value being part of it and actively recommend Elliptic to their peers and networks.

You will work closely with the Customer Success, Sales, and Product Marketing teams to build and own the agentic workflows that carry the program’s volume, so that you can run it across the full customer lifecycle. Customer Success owns the customer relationship. You will own the programmatic layer around it: the journeys, content, moments and proof that help every customer get value from Elliptic. Your role is to build relationships that make our customers want to talk about their work with Elliptic publicly.

Elliptic helps financial institutions, crypto businesses and governments manage risk and investigate illicit activity in digital assets. Since 2013 we have built one of the deepest on-chain data sets in the industry, and our risk intelligence supports compliance teams at banks, exchanges, payment firms and stablecoin issuers worldwide. In 2026 we raised a $120M Series D from investors including Nasdaq, JPMorgan and Deutsche Bank.

What you will do:

Including but not limited to the following:

Onboarding and adoption

  • Design and automate onboarding journeys for analysts, MLROs and the executive sponsor who decides on renewal, with content and communications triggered by HubSpot account events such as a signed contract, a new user or a missed adoption milestone.

  • Incorporate Elliptic Learn into onboarding so customer teams build skills from day one.

Value, retention and renewal

  • Build automated product update and launch communications that reach the right contacts in each account, triggered by product and account data.

  • Run executive briefings that give customers first access to product roadmaps, Intelligence research and regulatory analysis.

  • Collaborate with the product team on beta programs for our key enterprise customers.

  • Build renewal re-engagement workflows triggered by account health, and run them with Customer Success for accounts in the renewal cycle.

Advocacy and customer proof

  • Build the advocacy program, including an agent that flags likely advocates from call sentiment and engagement data for you to review and approach.

  • Build a fast pipeline for case studies, quotes, logos and speakers, with first drafts generated from customer interview transcripts and a human approval step before anything is published.

  • Make customer proof visible where buyers and AI assistants look for it, including case studies, review platforms and third-party coverage, working with the content and media teams.

  • Launch the Chief Customer Officer in Conversation program.

  • Supply customer voices for ABM, paid channels, media, events and executive platforms.

Community

  • Build a community of compliance practitioners, made up of customers and selected prospects, centred on peer access and candid discussion.

  • Start with high-value formats, such as an advisory board, regional roundtables under the Chatham House Rule and peer working groups, and grow into a wider platform as demand shows.

  • Feed recurring themes from the community back to Product, Intelligence and content.

  • Support tier 1 events with the Global Events Manager, including the annual customer event.

  • Feed customer voices into industry associations – go where the communities already exist.

How you will work

This role covers onboarding, retention, advocacy, community, events and industry associations. You will run that scope by designing, building and owning the agents and automated workflows that handle the repeatable work, so your own time goes on the relationships that build trust. We expect you to:

  • Build, maintain and improve the program’s agents and workflows, including those named above, and own their accuracy, performance and data governance.

  • Review everything AI produces before it reaches a customer or the market, with the editorial judgment a regulated audience expects.

  • Partner with CSMs who approve any outreach to their accounts, so automation and the advocate agent respect that

  • Spend the time this saves with customers: growing communities and advisory boards, developing advocates, supporting events, and creating thought leadership content with the Chief Customer Officer.

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • Reviewed and overhauled the current marketing and advocacy program into a lifecycle program with key moments identified to build marketing moments on

  • Optimized both the marketing to program using AI for the volume work, and the advocacy program allowing you to add human judgement for more valued interactions.

  • Have a pipeline of customer assets in progress across all geos and all ICPs, with production optimized where possible using automated workflows.

  • Identified communities and built a plan of how to work with them using our advocates and seeing content and communications.

How we will measure success

  • Leading indicators: adoption, advocates, references used in deals

  • Engagement and participation in customer marketing programs

  • Pipeline influenced by references, advocates and former champions

  • Volume of approved customer proof assets, and days from customer interview to approved asset

  • Active participation in community programs

  • Share of the program run through automated workflows

You will be a great fit here if you:

  • Are comfortable working in a hyper-fast, high-judgment environment where market conditions change regularly.

  • Have excellent written and verbal communication, with the judgement to know what a regulated audience will trust.

  • Build relationships that make customers want to talk about their work with Elliptic publicly.

Our ideal candidate has:

  • 6+ years in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing or customer advocacy at B2B SaaS or technology companies, ideally in financial services, compliance or digital assets.

  • A track record of building a customer advocacy programme or practitioner community that people chose to join and stay in.

  • Hands-on experience building AI workflows that replaced manual work. We will ask you to walk us through one at the interview.

  • Strong cross-functional skills, especially with Customer Success and Sales, and confidence working with senior executives at customer organisations.

  • Experience in a regulated industry, and comfort with the data governance it requires.

  • Fluent English.

Bonus Points for:

  • A background in financial services, compliance or digital assets.

  • Additional languages.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia.


To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/

We are seeking

We are seeking a Director, AI Datacenter Construction to lead delivery of multiple concurrent AI data center builds across Bitdeer’s U.S. portfolio. Reporting to the President of Global Power Land Infrastructure, you will own construction execution for high-density AI campuses, new builds, and retrofits, from site diligence and design through energization, Level 1–5 commissioning, and turnover to operations, with accountability for safety, schedule, cost, and quality on every site.

You will lead site construction managers and discipline leads, set one delivery playbook across all builds, and manage general contractors, utility partners, and design consultants. The ideal candidate has delivered hundreds of megawatts of critical capacity from the owner’s side at a hyperscaler or AI infrastructure company, has delivered liquid-cooled AI data halls, and can run several sites at once without losing control of cost or schedule.

What you will be responsible for

Multi-Site Construction Leadership

  • Portfolio Delivery: Lead construction of multiple concurrent AI data center builds, from site diligence and design through energization, commissioning, and ready-for-service (RFS).
  • Team Leadership: Build, lead, and mentor site construction managers, project managers, and discipline leads, and help recruit hyperscale-experienced talent as the portfolio grows.
  • Delivery Standards: Standardize construction processes, playbooks, and reporting across sites so each build is faster and more predictable than the last.

Pre-Construction, Design & Power

  • Design Reviews: Lead multidisciplinary reviews of civil, structural, architectural, electrical, and mechanical design packages to resolve constructability, cost, and schedule issues before they reach the field.
  • Power & Interconnection: Coordinate substation interconnection, utility and EPC partners, outage planning, and energization milestones, and resolve easement, land, and permitting constraints.
  • Delivery Models: Execute across self-build, build-to-suit, and colocation/third-party delivery models, including tenant fit-outs.

AI & High-Density Infrastructure

  • Liquid Cooling: Deliver direct-to-chip liquid cooling and high-density power distribution for GPU/AI workloads.
  • Fit-Out Integration: Coordinate base-building construction with network, fiber, and rack deployment teams so data halls are ready for compute on schedule.
  • Retrofits & Conversions: Plan and execute retrofits and conversions of existing facilities into AI-ready capacity while protecting live operations.

Cost, Contracts & Procurement

  • Budget & EAC: Own site budgets, Estimate at Completion (EAC) forecasts, owner’s contingency, and value engineering across the portfolio.
  • Change Control: Review and approve contractor change orders and scope changes, requiring clear labor and material splits and Owner-Furnished, Contractor-Installed (OFCI) documentation.
  • Contractor & Supply Chain Strategy: Select and manage general contractors, electrical contractors, trade partners, and consultants based on regional labor markets and vendor capacity, and direct procurement of long-lead equipment and structural steel.

Tenant & Stakeholder Management

  • Tenant Requirements: Support Site-Specific Owner Project Requirements (SSOPR) negotiations with hyperscale and AI tenants, and set commissioning frameworks that protect schedule and RFS dates.
  • Stakeholder Governance: Set clear communication protocols between Bitdeer, tenants, and contractors to reduce silos and speed conflict resolution, and lead site visits for prospective tenants and investors.
  • Executive Reporting: Report status, risks, and decision options to the President of GPLI and executive leadership, with clear cost, schedule, and risk trade-offs.

Safety, Quality & Turnover

  • Safety Leadership: Enforce a zero-harm safety culture, including OSHA compliance, Method of Procedure (MOP), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and energization safety in live environments.
  • Quality & Commissioning: Run QA/QC programs, root cause failure analysis (RCFA), and Level 1–5 commissioning so facilities meet design intent and tenant requirements.
  • Turnover & Compliance: Deliver structured closeout and digital asset handover to operations and client CMMS platforms, and oversee incentive and labor compliance (e.g., IRA/ITC, prevailing wage and apprenticeship).

How you will stand out

  • Experience: 12+ years in data center, mission-critical, or large-scale construction, including 5+ years leading owner-side hyperscale or AI data center construction.
  • Multi-Site Scale: Proven delivery of multiple concurrent builds or multi-building campuses totaling 300MW+ of critical capacity, with capital budgets of $1B+.
  • AI & Liquid Cooling: Hands-on delivery of AI/ML-ready, high-density, or liquid-cooled data centers, including direct-to-chip cooling.
  • Delivery Models: Experience across self-build, colocation, and third-party data center delivery, including tenant fit-outs.
  • Technical Breadth: Working knowledge of civil, structural, electrical, and mechanical systems, MV/HV power distribution, substation interconnection, and Level 1–5 commissioning.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Structural, Electrical, Mechanical, or Architectural Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Certifications: Professional certifications such as PE, PMP, OSHA 30/40-Hour, or LEED.
  • Industry Background: Construction leadership at a hyperscaler, AI cloud provider, or large data center developer.
  • Cost & Commercial Control: Strong command of EAC forecasting, owner’s contingency, change-order control, value engineering, and OFCI procurement.
  • Process Standardization: Track record of building standard construction processes and playbooks across multiple regions or programs.
  • Public-Sector & Permitting: Experience working with jurisdictions, inspectors, and building codes; military or public-sector engineering experience is a plus.
  • Hands-On Leadership: Leads from the field, develops construction managers, and builds disciplined, accountable teams.
  • Commercial Negotiation: Holds firm in tenant and contractor negotiations while keeping relationships productive.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Aligns engineering, operations, finance, tenants, utilities, and local authorities around one plan.
  • Safety & Quality Mindset: Holds the line on safety and quality while delivering at speed.


What you will experience working with us

  • A culture that values authenticity and diverse perspectives.
  • An inclusive, respectful environment with open workspaces and an energetic, start-up spirit.
  • A fast-growing company with opportunities to network with industry pioneers and enthusiasts.
  • The ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset and AI computing industry.
  • Involvement in new projects and in developing processes/systems.
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, rapid growth, and learning opportunities.
  • Attractive benefits and development such as training and mentoring.

Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, color, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Developer Operations (DevOps) at Ripple manages communication, collaboration, and integration between Development and Operations teams. They ensure infrastructures, tools, and processes are streamlined and effective for automated product delivery.

The Senior Software Engineer, DevOps will contribute to the discovery, development, and implementation of solutions to improve infrastructure and release pipelines. These solutions will include developer infrastructure, production infrastructure layout and maintenance, capacity and load testing, CI/CD infrastructure, and release process automation. You will push the boundaries with new tools and technologies and use a data-driven approach for achieving desired results. You will play a critical role helping to advance Ripple's development and production infrastructure, improving our DevOps process including deployment, monitoring, instrumentation and overall infrastructure management.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain Ripple’s multi-region, multi-provider service platforms
  • Supply build and development of tools for automation, monitoring, and instrumentation to reduce operational friction and increase engineering efficiency
  • Work with wider engineering teams on implementation, adoption, and continuous improvements
  • Build and automate new and existing platform and application lifecycle services, using data to converge on declared states with minimal human interaction
  • Collaborate with product engineering to ensure code is production-ready
  • Participate in the adoption of DevOps-first principles within the organization

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering.
  • Extensive hands-on experience managing cloud infrastructure, deployments, and large-scale, multi-region distributed systems, preferably on Azure and AWS
  • Strong proficiency in Kubernetes and experience managing container orchestration platforms and runtimes, including Docker and OCI.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform , Azure Bicep and AWS CloudFormation.
  • Strong understanding of platform engineering fundamentals, including automation, reliability, scalability, high availability, and operational excellence.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, including automated environment provisioning, regression testing, and containerized build and deployment workflows.
  • Experience managing artifact repositories and storage systems for build dependencies and pipeline artifacts.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux operating systems, networking fundamentals, and scripting languages such as Bash and Python.
  • Experience operating, administering, and troubleshooting production infrastructure, with a focus on performance, security, and reliability.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments and collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams.

About Open Standard

Open Standard is building internet-native money. Data moved to the cloud, and dollars will move onchain. When they do, stablecoins become core financial infrastructure.

Our stablecoin, Open USD (OUSD), is built for that shift. Minting and redeeming are free at any volume. Nearly all reserve revenue goes back to the businesses that grow adoption. The partners who use OUSD govern it, rather than a single issuer.

OUSD is live on Base, Ethereum, Solana, and Tempo. Our founding partners are Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe, and Visa, and more than 200 banks, payment networks, fintechs, and crypto companies have signed up to use OUSD. Our CEO is Zach Abrams, who co-founded Bridge (acquired by Stripe for $1.1B) and previously led product at Brex, Coinbase, and Square.

OS is currently a team of about ten. We have a real shot at being the next inevitable transformation in stablecoins. We're hiring someone to help make us inevitable.

The role

We're hiring a Deputy General Counsel to help build the legal function at Open Standard alongside our General Counsel, a Founding Team member of Open Standard, who was also part of the founding team of Bridge. You'll be a partner to the GC, not a direct report in the usual sense. The two of you will divide the work by comparative advantage, and you'll own your areas end to end. We are AI-centric, highly scaled, and don't plan on building a large legal team for the foreseeable future. You'll do the work yourself, with AI agents and a tight group of outside counsel extending your reach.

Legal sits at the center of OS's business. You'll be integrated into OUSD design choices, partner deals, and launch decisions, all of which present needle moving commercial opportunities that depend on thoughtful legal decision making that unlocks value for the business.

What you'll do

  • Shape the product with our product and engineering teams: mint and redemption flows, partner rewards, wallet and chain integrations, and new use cases from cross-border payments to agentic commerce.

  • Structure and negotiate the deals OUSD runs on: network partner agreements, reserve and custody relationships, exchange and liquidity arrangements, and agreements with chains and protocols.

  • Work directly with the world's largest banks, card networks, and asset managers, answering their diligence, risk, and regulatory questions with credibility.

  • Find the creative structure when the easy answer is "no": the deal term, product change, or regulatory path that gets a partner live.

  • Help steward a new kind of governance model, with a company owned and governed by the partners who use its product.

  • Support our Head of Policy on regulator and policymaker engagement, comment letters, and industry work.

  • Assist with regulatory strategy for OUSD under the GENIUS Act and state and international regimes. This covers licensing paths, issuer and reserve arrangements, and how rewards and distribution are treated.

  • Build an AI-native legal function, using agents and workflows for contract review, diligence questionnaires, regulatory tracking, and partner questions.

  • Manage outside counsel in the US and abroad tightly, and know when not to use them.

You may be a good fit if you

  • Have 10+ years of legal experience, including substantial in-house time at crypto companies.

  • Know the stablecoin market cold from three angles: commercial, regulatory, and product. You can explain how issuers make money, how reserves and redemption work, what GENIUS changes, and where the market is going next.

  • Have worked with or inside large financial institutions and understand how banks, card networks, and asset managers make decisions. You earn their trust without starting to act like them.

  • Have creative commercial instincts and use them to shape deals and products, not just paper them. You're a regulatory and product lawyer who structures deals, not a contracts specialist who knows crypto.

  • Are scrappy and do the work yourself, from the first draft to the board memo.

  • Already use AI seriously in your practice, and have built agents or workflows that expand what one lawyer can do.

  • Write clearly and precisely, because most decisions here start in writing.

  • Are admitted to practice in a US jurisdiction.

Strong candidates may also have

  • Worked in-house at a stablecoin issuer

  • Worked in a bank's digital assets group, alongside crypto-native experience

  • Worked on stablecoin or payments licensing: trust charters, state money transmission, or non-US regimes such as MiCA

  • Helped build the legal function at an early-stage company

  • Relationships with regulators, policymakers, or industry groups in payments and digital assets
